USBLC6-2SC6, package SOT-23-6, library type Extended) ; LCSC product record for C2687116 (the data behind https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C2687116.html, fetched from wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C2687116) read 2026-11-11 (UMW USBLC6-2SC6, SOT-23-6, ESD protection, 2 channels, Vrwm 5V, Vbr 6V, clamping 15V, Ipp 6A (8/20us), 150W; listed stock 74560) ; datasheet: UMW USBLC6-2SC6 (UTD Semiconductor, Nov.2024; the PDF of https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/cb339b3dae40ca0f3986b4e9f6690755.pdf, 7 pages, SHA-256 973ea7520f3c): page 1 section 4 Pinning information (the SOT-23-6 figure with the pad numbers); page 2 section 5 Absolute Maximum Ratings (junction temperature -55 to 125 C); page 3 section 6 Electrical Characteristic (VRWM 5 V, VBR 6 V min and 9 V max at 1 mA, IR 0.1 uA at 5 V, VC 10 V at 1 A and 15 V at 6 A, CJ 0.8 pF typ and 1 pF max I/O to GND, 0.35 pF typ and 0.4 pF max I/O to I/O); page 5 section 8 package outline (SOT-23-6) ; the number is the LCSC property of U6 of the charger module's board file (reference/charger-module.kicad_pcb)
notes: **UMW's USBLC6-2SC6, not ST's.** The reference board's schematic names the part USBLC6-2SC6 (ST's name, with ST's land pattern in KiCad's SOT-23-6); LCSC and JLCPCB sell UMW's part of the same name under C2687116, and its datasheet is the one read. The pinout is the usual one (pad 1 I/O1, 2 GND, 3 I/O2, 4 I/O2, 5 VBUS, 6 I/O1) and is printed in UMW's page 1 figure. No other figure is a catalog column; the figures read are in the source cell. temp_min and temp_max are the datasheet's junction temperature range (TJ in the absolute maximum table), not an ambient one. The footprint is the generator's SOT-23-6 (the reference board's pads agree: Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23-6). Price not recorded. Pins: src/usblc6_2sc6.nsm.
